name: Ipilimumab
mechanism: Fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody that blocks CTLA-4, enhancing T-cell priming and activation in lymphoid tissue and depleting intratumoural regulatory T cells. Used with nivolumab in NSCLC and mesothelioma.
keyToxicities: Colitis and diarrhoea (more frequent than with PD-1 blockade)
monitoring: Baseline and periodic thyroid function, liver function, renal function and glucose
Clinical assessment for new respiratory, gastrointestinal, cutaneous, neurological or cardiac symptoms; low threshold for imaging and specialist input
Cortisol and pituitary axis assessment when symptoms suggest hypophysitis or adrenal insufficiency
Troponin and ECG if myocarditis is suspected
resistance: Combination CTLA-4/PD-1 blockade may benefit some tumours with low PD-L1 expression; mechanisms of resistance overlap with PD-1 blockade.
